evals.name: interactive-non-atomic-on-approved-srd
evals.setup: `specs/login.md` carries `Status: ACCEPTED`. `GR-3a` reads "The system SHALL validate the token and log the attempt" — two rules in one requirement — and `GR-3b` already exists beside it. The approving authority has not been consulted.

evals.name: apply-a-review-file
evals.setup: `specs/login.review.md` holds findings across all three severities.

evals.name: targeted-edit-by-description
evals.setup: One requirement says the response must be "fast". The user names it by description rather than by id.

evals.name: polish-leaves-metadata-and-meaning
evals.setup: An in-progress draft with British spellings, a lowercase normative keyword, stray example text, and empty Owners/Initiative/Designs fields.

evals.name: terse-output
evals.setup: An ordinary interactive session with several applied edits.

evals.name: generate-in-scope-on-signal
evals.setup: `### In Scope` holds only the `--- TODO ---` marker. Partway through the session the user says the requirements are final and asks for In Scope to be filled.

evals.name: add-to-todo-on-demand
evals.setup: Mid-session, with a `## TODO` section already present holding two items.
evals.query: Add: confirm the lockout threshold with security to TODO

evals.name: autofix-bulk-applies-errata
evals.setup: `specs/login.review.md` has an `## Errata` block of three findings. Two anchors still match their quoted `old` text exactly once; the third entry has since been reworded, so its anchor no longer contains the quoted text.

evals.name: feedback-from-a-finding-number
evals.setup: `specs/login.review.md` exists and holds numbered findings. The run is repeated in a second scenario where the review file is absent.

evals.name: corpus-grounded-edit-routes-the-unconfirmable
evals.setup: The `srd-doc` corpus is reachable. The user wants `GR-2` to say the gateway retries a failed token check three times; the retry count appears in no document.

evals.name: session-start-drains-prior-buffers
evals.setup: A previous session for this SRD ended with two unfiled doc gaps and one unwritten platform fact still buffered.

evals.name: decision-log-written-per-edit
evals.setup: No `specs/login.decisions.md` exists yet. The user answers `Y` to one proposal with the reason "retention isn't ours, drop it", then `S` to the next.

evals.name: removal-on-an-approved-srd
evals.setup: `specs/login.md` is `ACCEPTED`. A review finding says `GR-6` duplicates `GR-2` and should be removed. The approving authority has agreed to the removal.

evals.name: finding-outside-the-mandate
evals.setup: `specs/login.review.md` finding `#2` is a metadata gap — no Initiative link (STR-3) — which `edit` may not fix. The run is asked to enter at that finding.

evals.name: autofix-writes-the-decision-log
evals.setup: An `## Errata` block of three findings, two of which apply cleanly. No `specs/login.decisions.md` exists yet.
